config_authority: Separate externally controlled review process; packet must not choose config/catalog. Shipped fixture config/catalog are author controlled and convey no independent review.
artifact_encoding: Embedded UTF-8 strings, canonical relative POSIX paths, SHA256 over exact UTF-8 bytes; no external file fetching or execution. JSON duplicate keys and nonfinite tokens rejected. Bounds use rational strings. Samples use canonical finite binary64 hex pairs.

roles.samples: 1024 signed complex residual samples in V, ordered indices and reviewed original sample bytes
roles.clock: Reviewed timestamp bytes and calibration supporting true sample times, affine error <=10ppb, total per-sample residual <=10ns
roles.iq_path: Full path including extraction, frequency response, voltage, loading and conditioning; operator error <=1e-6 at two-vector norm <=5V
roles.error_budget: Deterministic complex sample RMS triangle shares <=10/5/3/2 microvolts; matrix share >=IQ output error
roles.source_class: Fixed coefficients/frequencies over monitor and acquisition coverage; modes100..199, T0=1s, per-mode error <=5mHz; independent preparation/completeness witness
roles.outside_tv: Independent complex spectral-measure TV <=10microvolts; same-output FFT/statistical/model-only evidence unsupported
roles.transfer: Reviewed simultaneous same preparation and epoch; same residual complex spectral measure on entire coverage, not a later monitor applied to a historical file
roles.computation: Pinned inherited method/contract/theorem hashes, exact recomputed sample energy/RMS, rational Gram floor9/10, norm factor211/20, design-tail calculation
roles.tail_tv: Derived deterministic uniform bound; only unsigned proposal output

review_scope: Every node needs an allowlisted receipt binding exact node and witness bytes, role, run/profile and fixture designation. Different reviewer label is necessary but cannot authenticate nonconstructor independence.
dependencies: All references resolve, are unique and acyclic; exact required edges enforced by DEPS in admit_monitor.py. Source/outside/clock/IQ roots cannot depend on target output.
success_meaning: STRUCTURALLY_READY_FIXTURE or STRUCTURALLY_READY_FOR_REVIEW; empirical_admission always false, Physical Promotion0; independently reviewed scientific acceptance remains separate.
integration: Output is UD_UNSIGNED_MONITOR_TAIL_PROPOSAL_1, not an admissible v0.1 acquisition packet. Requires independent bridge review and policy/version change or reviewed evidence import before discharging tail_tv. Other eleven acquisition roles remain required.
limits: No verification of scientific witness text or calibration truth
No proof that arbitrary uploaded timestamps are true physical times
No outside-TV conclusion from samples alone
No prospective monitor applied to historical data
